mapper.select: SELECT E.ENDPOINT_ID,E.HTTP_METHOD,E.PATH,E.CONTROLLER_CLASS,E.HANDLER_METHOD,E.COLLECTION_STATUS, CASE WHEN M.ENDPOINT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'MAPPED' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BSYPREP R JOIN BSYPROG P ON P.PROGRAM_ID=R.PROGRAM_ID AND P.DEL_YN='N' WHERE R.ENDPOINT_ID=E.ENDPOINT_ID) THEN 'OTHER_PROGRAM' ELSE 'UNMAPPED' END AS MAPPING_STATUS, M.GROUP_CODE FROM BSYENDP E LEFT JOIN BSYPREP M ON M.ENDPOINT_ID=E.ENDPOINT_ID AND M.PROGRAM_ID=#{PROGRAM_ID} ORDER BY E.PATH,E.HTTP_METHOD,E.ENDPOINT_ID
SELECT GROUP_CODE,GROUP_TYPE,GROUP_NAME,DESCRIPTION,USE_YN FROM BSYBTGP WHERE PROGRAM_ID=#{PROGRAM_ID} ORDER BY GROUP_CODE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BSYENDP WHERE ENDPOINT_ID=#{ENDPOINT_ID}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM BSYPREP WHERE PROGRAM_ID=#{PROGRAM_ID} AND ENDPOINT_ID=#{ENDPOINT_ID}
mapper.select: SELECT P.PROGRAM_KEY,R.GROUP_CODE, CASE WHEN P.USE_YN='Y' AND (R.GROUP_CODE IS NULL OR G.USE_YN='Y') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS USE_YN FROM BSYPREP R JOIN BSYPROG P ON P.PROGRAM_ID=R.PROGRAM_ID AND P.DEL_YN='N' LEFT JOIN BSYBTGP G ON G.PROGRAM_ID=R.PROGRAM_ID AND G.GROUP_CODE=R.GROUP_CODE WHERE R.ENDPOINT_ID=#{ENDPOINT_ID}
